title: Validate repair reconcile pending drain bridge
summary: Added representative generated-runtime validation for the repair/reconcile orphan-payload apply path. The new Local API test repairs a backend-authorized pending manifest, proves the apply route writes only manifest state and records only the repair command, then invokes the real MediaPipeline.ps1 -DrainPendingPushes entrypoint to prove the repaired manifest drains into the final output while leaving source media unchanged.
reason: The repair/reconcile operator surface had route, WebView, and temp-fixture apply coverage, but the deferred publish/drain handoff still needed evidence that a repaired orphan-payload manifest remains compatible with the backend-owned pending drain flow.
behavior_before: Pending orphan-payload reconcile apply was covered as repair-only Local API mutation, but docs still listed operator/runtime deferred publish/drain validation as open.
behavior_after: Pending orphan-payload reconcile apply is covered through the real drain entrypoint in a temp fixture: apply creates only the backend-authorized manifest, source/output/payload are unchanged before drain, the command journal records no drain, DrainPendingPushes publishes the output bytes, removes the parked payload/manifest, writes a successful drain summary, and leaves the source unchanged.
rollback_plan: Revert the added test, generated summary updates, and documentation status changes. The production repair/apply and drain behavior is not modified by this packet.
notes:
